# find white swatch node (small white object in top HUD area)
ws=None

        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]

action(['RIGHT','RIGHT','UP','LEFT'])
def piece_bbox(frame):

print('piece now', piece_bbox(current_frame))
r,c = (ws[0]+ws[1])//2, (ws[2]+ws[3])//2
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
print('piece color after swatch:', piece_bbox(current_frame))
action(['SPACE'])
rows=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print('square after white pour:')
[print(rows[rr][27:37]) for rr in range(34,44)]
